source: Phasmophobia Fandom ghost pages and current 30-entry roster; behavior and evidence checked against the Deildegast-era roster. See README.md for references.

ghosts.name: Aswang

speedProfiles.label: base
speedProfiles.condition: during hunts before line of sight

speedProfiles.label: line of sight
speedProfiles.condition: maximum after about 8.67 seconds of line of sight

tells: Has a 1.53 m/s hunt base speed and accelerates at 0.075 times its base speed per second while it has line of sight.
Reaches a maximum of 2.53 m/s after about 8.67 seconds of line of sight, faster than a standard ghost's acceleration.
Can sometimes start a hunt with no grace period.
Cannot kill a player inside an available official hiding spot, but targets that spot for the next hunt after reaching it.
The no-kill hiding-spot weakness does not apply to unofficial hiding places or contracts with no available hiding spots.

ghosts.name: Banshee
tells: Selects one hunt target and checks that player's sanity instead of average team sanity.
Uses a 50% target sanity hunt threshold and ignores non-target players during a hunt when the target is inside.
Has an increased chance of singing ghost events and can roam toward its target outside hunts.
Has a 33% chance to produce one of its unique screams through a Parabolic Microphone or Sound Recorder.
Can only be female, including its name, model, and vocalization.

ghosts.name: Dayan

speedProfiles.label: still nearby
speedProfiles.condition: closest player is still within 10 m

speedProfiles.label: moving nearby
speedProfiles.condition: closest player is walking within 10 m

tells: Within 10 m of the ghost, a still closest player lowers its hunt threshold to 45% and fixes its speed at 1.2 m/s.
Within 10 m of the ghost, a walking closest player raises its hunt threshold to 65% and fixes its speed at 2.25 m/s.
With no player within 10 m, it uses standard hunt behavior and threshold.
Its line-of-sight acceleration can build in the background while a player is nearby, then apply after leaving the 10 m range.
Can only be female, including its name, model, and vocalization.

ghosts.name: Deildegast

speedProfiles.label: fresh
speedProfiles.condition: start of contract or after a reset

speedProfiles.label: after 9 props
speedProfiles.condition: 9 unique eligible props moved or interacted with

speedProfiles.label: standard
speedProfiles.condition: 13 unique eligible props moved or interacted with

speedProfiles.label: minimum
speedProfiles.condition: 26 or more unique eligible props moved or interacted with

tells: Starts hunts at a fixed 3.0 m/s and has no line-of-sight acceleration.
Loses 0.1 m/s for each unique prop moved or interacted with by players, including dead players, down to 0.4 m/s.
Eligible interactions include throwable props, light switches, the fuse box, and taps; cursed possessions, doors, and equipment do not count.
Reaches 2.1 m/s after 9 eligible props, standard 1.7 m/s after 13, and minimum 0.4 m/s after 26.
Resets to 3.0 m/s after every hunt and after a crucifix burns.
Has a 10% chance to interact with doors or light switches instead of the standard 25%, and succeeds on ordinary prop interactions 85% of the time.
A failed prop interaction sends it to the favourite-room state.

ghosts.name: Demon
tells: Normally has a 70% hunt sanity threshold instead of 50%.
Can use a special hunt ability at any sanity level, subject to normal prevention methods.
Has a minimum hunt cooldown of 20 seconds instead of 25 seconds.
Incense prevents its hunts for 60 seconds instead of 90 seconds.
Crucifix effective range is 50% larger: 4.5 m, 6 m, or 7.5 m for tiers I, II, or III.

ghosts.name: Deogen

speedProfiles.label: far
speedProfiles.condition: more than 6 m pathfinding distance from target

speedProfiles.label: near
speedProfiles.condition: close to target; scales with pathfinding distance

tells: Always has line of sight to players during hunts and cannot be defeated by hiding.
Moves at 3.0 m/s when more than 6 m from its target, then slows to pathfinding distance multiplied by 0.15 m/s within 6 m, with a 0.4 m/s minimum.
Chooses the nearest player, focuses them for 10 seconds, and can repick a target every 5-10 seconds.
Has a 40% hunt sanity threshold and is more likely to interact with doors.
Has a 33% chance to give a unique heavy breathing response when asked a Spirit Box question within 1 m.
Is visible for substantially longer during hunts than a standard ghost.

ghosts.name: Gallu
tells: Has normal, enraged, and weakened states that change its hunt threshold, speed, crucifix range, and incense duration.
Normal state uses a 50% threshold and 1.7 m/s; enraged uses 60% and 1.955 m/s; weakened uses 40% and 1.36 m/s.
Burning a crucifix or ending an incense blind during a hunt can push it into the enraged state.
Ending a hunt while enraged immediately makes it weakened; stepping in salt later moves it toward normal.
Cannot disturb salt while enraged, while weakened salt footprints can last up to 3 seconds instead of 2.
Incense blinds it for 4 seconds enraged, 5 seconds normal, and 6 seconds weakened.

ghosts.name: Goryo
tells: Can enter a D.O.T.S. state only when no player is in its room.
Its D.O.T.S. silhouette is visible only through a video camera, not directly.
Has a 2/3 chance to enter D.O.T.S. from a roam instead of the standard 1/3 chance.
Only performs short roams and cannot change its favourite room, except through special Monkey Paw behavior.
Is less likely to roam and therefore tends to remain near its starting room.
D.O.T.S. is guaranteed as one of its evidence types on limited-evidence games.

ghosts.name: Hantu

speedProfiles.label: 12-15 C
speedProfiles.condition: room temperature from 12 C to 15 C

speedProfiles.label: 9-12 C
speedProfiles.condition: room temperature from 9 C to 12 C

speedProfiles.label: 6-9 C
speedProfiles.condition: room temperature from 6 C to 9 C

speedProfiles.label: 3-6 C
speedProfiles.condition: room temperature from 3 C to 6 C

speedProfiles.label: 0-3 C
speedProfiles.condition: room temperature from 0 C to 3 C

tells: Hunt speed is determined by room temperature, ranging from 1.4 m/s above 15 C to 2.7 m/s below 0 C.
Changes speed as it crosses temperature bands and does not gain line-of-sight acceleration.
Emits visible freezing breath near its head every 3 seconds during a hunt when the fuse box is off.
Cannot turn the fuse box on and is twice as likely to turn it off.
Freezing Temperatures is guaranteed as one of its evidence types on limited-evidence games.

ghosts.name: Jinn

speedProfiles.label: ability
speedProfiles.condition: breaker on, line of sight, and more than 3 m from target

tells: With the fuse box on, line of sight, and more than 3 m from its target, moves at a fixed 2.5 m/s during a hunt.
Uses standard movement otherwise, while line-of-sight acceleration can build in the background during the 2.5 m/s state.
Can drain 25% sanity from a nearby player after a delay and create EMF 2 or 5 at the fuse box.
Cannot use its abilities when the fuse box is off and cannot directly turn the fuse box off.
Turning on too many lights can still indirectly trip the fuse box.

ghosts.name: Kormos

speedProfiles.label: detection waypoint
speedProfiles.condition: travelling to a detection waypoint without line of sight

tells: Has a 50% hunt sanity threshold, raised to 70% when a player sprints in its room.
Is nearly blind: it normally has no line of sight and only gains it within 5 m with no obstacles.
Can hear sprinting footsteps within 30 m, standing-walk footsteps within 15 m, and crouch-walk footsteps within 10 m on the same floor.
Has a 1.7 m/s base speed and moves at 1.3 times its current speed while travelling to a detection waypoint without line of sight.
Can update a detection waypoint every 5-10 seconds instead of waiting to reach the previous waypoint.
Cannot perform mist-form or chasing ghost events.

ghosts.name: Mare
tells: Uses a 60% hunt threshold when its current room is dark and 40% when that room is lit.
Cannot turn lights on and prefers turning them off; it cannot perform the light-flicker interaction at a switch.
Has a 1/7 chance to turn a nearby light off within 1 second after a player turns it on, with a per-player 10-second cooldown.
Has an increased chance of light-shattering ghost events and can roam more when its current room is lit.
Other light sources, firelights, TVs, computers, and the fuse box do not change its hunt threshold.

ghosts.name: Moroi
tells: Can curse a player through a successful Spirit Box response, Parabolic Microphone sound, or Sound Recorder recording.
A curse doubles passive sanity drain in the investigation area and is removed by sanity medication.
Hunt speed rises as average sanity falls, from 1.5 m/s at 45% or higher to 2.25 m/s below 5%.
Its speed can change during a hunt as average sanity changes and can still gain normal line-of-sight acceleration.
Incense blinds it for about 7 seconds instead of the standard 5 seconds.

ghosts.name: Myling
tells: Hunt footsteps and vocalizations are audible only within 12 m instead of the usual 20 m.
Produces paranormal sounds every 64-127 seconds instead of 80-127 seconds.
The electronic interference range remains about 10 m, allowing a sound-versus-electronics range test.
Has no unique hunt speed profile.

ghosts.name: Obake
tells: Has a 75% chance to leave fingerprints after a valid surface interaction and a 75% chance to leave a footprint after salt.
Has about a 1/6 chance to leave unique fingerprints: six fingers, two on switches/remotes, or five on keyboards/cell doors.
Can halve the remaining duration of all existing fingerprints as an ability.
Can miss a footprint sound during a fake hunt or Music Box event.
Can briefly shapeshift into another same-gender model during a hunt, with the first shift occurring around 6-8 seconds after grace period.
Ultraviolet is guaranteed as one of its evidence types on limited-evidence games.

ghosts.name: Obambo
tells: Starts calm, then switches state 1 minute after the exit door first opens and every 2 minutes afterward.
Calm state uses a 10% hunt threshold, 1.445 m/s speed, and activity level 90.
Aggressive state uses a 65% hunt threshold, 1.955 m/s speed, and activity level 25.
A hunt started while aggressive lasts 20% less time, even if the state changes during the hunt.
Can switch states during a hunt, causing an unexplained speed change and distinct high/low activity phases.

ghosts.name: Oni
tells: Activity increases by 30 when a player is within 6 m or in the same room.
Cannot perform the mist-form ghost event and has a 40% chance of the chasing event instead of 20%.
Has a 2/3 chance to appear in full form during a manifestation instead of a shadow or translucent form.
Drains 20% sanity when colliding with a player during an event instead of the normal 10%.
Is visible for longer and flickers less often during hunts.

ghosts.name: Onryo
tells: Cannot naturally light candles, campfires, or fireplaces and is more likely to blow out flames as more players die.
After three flame blowouts, can attempt a hunt at any sanity once it exits an idle state.
A flame within 4 m prevents a normal hunt attempt by making it blow out the flame instead.
Uses a 60% hunt threshold by default and 40% while within 4 m of a flame.
A flame blown out during a hunt or while preventing a hunt still increments its blowout counter.
Can be ruled out if it naturally lights a fire source.

ghosts.name: Phantom
tells: A successful photo or video makes it physically disappear from an event, D.O.T.S. state, or briefly during a hunt.
Is visible for only about 11.5-14% of hunt flicker time instead of about 31-33% for a standard ghost.
Drains 0.5% sanity per second from a nearby player in pseudo line of sight during an event or hunt.
Can roam directly to a random player and create EMF 2 at the destination near head level.
A Phantom photo contains no visible ghost and no interference pattern, aside from possible desync edge cases.

ghosts.name: Poltergeist
tells: Has a 20% chance to throw a prop when interacting and cannot successfully perform non-throw interactions with props.
Can throw objects with substantially more force than other ghosts.
Can throw every 0.5 seconds during a hunt when nearby objects are available.
Can use a multi-throw ability that throws all nearby items and drains 2% sanity per item from players in the room.
The multi-throw ability creates head-level EMF 2 while individual thrown items create EMF 3.
Is ineffective in an empty area with no throwable objects.

ghosts.name: Raiju

speedProfiles.label: electronic surge
speedProfiles.condition: near active electronics during a hunt

tells: Near active electronics during a hunt, uses a 2.5 m/s speed and a 65% hunt threshold.
The electronic speed range is 6 m on small maps, 8 m on medium maps, and 10 m on large maps.
Can build line-of-sight acceleration in the background while its fixed electronic speed is active.
Disrupts electronics and causes heartbeats within 15 m instead of the usual 10 m.
Active held or dropped equipment can empower it, while inventory items and several placed sensors do not count.

ghosts.name: Revenant

speedProfiles.label: detected
speedProfiles.condition: player detected during hunt until last known location

tells: Moves at 1.0 m/s while roaming without detecting a player.
Jumps to 3.0 m/s after detecting a player through sight, voice, or electronics and holds that speed until reaching the last known location.
Slows back to 1.0 m/s over about 2.7 seconds after losing the player.
Does not gain normal continuous line-of-sight acceleration.

ghosts.name: Shade
tells: Cannot interact, perform ghost events, or start a hunt when a living player is in its current room.
Cannot hunt above 35% average sanity and is generally less active than other ghosts.
At 100% average sanity it has a 0% chance of a successful ordinary ghost event, rising as sanity falls.
Cannot perform singing or appear events and has a 60% chance to perform the mist-form event.
Has a 2/3 chance to appear as a shadow during ordinary manifestations.

ghosts.name: Spirit
tells: Has no unique movement, activity, or hunt behavior and serves as the baseline ghost.
Incense prevents it from initiating hunts for 180 seconds instead of the standard 90 seconds.
The extended incense prevention also applies when it is smudged during a hunt.
A hunt between 90 and 180 seconds after a successful incense test rules it out; a hunt after 180 seconds supports it.

ghosts.name: Thaye
tells: Starts at 2.75 m/s with a 75% hunt threshold and activity level 200.
Ages when a player is in the same room or within 3 m, usually retrying after 1-2 minutes or 30 seconds if nobody is nearby.
Each age reduces hunt threshold by 6%, speed by 0.175 m/s, and activity by 15%, to a minimum profile of 1.0 m/s and 15% threshold.
Does not gain line-of-sight acceleration and has a fixed 1/8 hunt-attempt chance below its current threshold.
Starts very active and dangerous, then becomes progressively quieter, slower, and less willing to hunt near players.

ghosts.name: The Mimic

speedProfiles.label: copied
speedProfiles.condition: copies another ghost; that ghost's conditional profiles apply

tells: Can imitate every other ghost's interactions, events, hunt thresholds, speeds, and abilities, changing periodically.
Starts in a blank state, then first attempts to change 1 minute after the exit door opens and every 30 seconds to 2 minutes afterward.
Cannot copy the evidence types of the ghost it is imitating, but can copy behavior tied to evidence such as Obake fingerprints or Deogen breathing.
Always produces false Ghost Orbs in addition to its three actual evidence types, including on zero-evidence games.
A conflicting evidence and behavior combination, such as a Banshee scream with Spirit Box evidence, strongly identifies it.
Can imitate newer ghost behaviors such as Aswang, Kormos, and Deildegast.

ghosts.name: The Twins
tells: Can produce interactions in two locations within about 1-2 seconds, including a 20% double-interaction ability.
The large interaction range can reach much farther than a normal ghost and can mislead players about the favourite room.
Chooses a 1.5 m/s or 1.9 m/s hunt profile with equal chance, producing a subtle speed change between hunts.
The faster choice can start from the last large-range interaction location; cursed hunts still choose speed but start from the current location.
It is one ghost, so it cannot hunt or produce evidence in two places simultaneously.

ghosts.name: Wraith
tells: Never steps in or disturbs salt, including Tier III salt during a hunt.
Can teleport to a random player outside hunts and create EMF 2, with a 33% chance of EMF 5, at the player's feet.
Teleporting can create activity far from the favourite room and can cause a hunt to begin near the destination.
Does not float, walk through walls, or have quieter footsteps despite its folklore description.

ghosts.name: Yokai
tells: Voice chat in the same room increases its activity by 30 and temporarily raises its hunt threshold to 80%.
Without nearby talking, uses the standard 50% hunt threshold.
During hunts can hear voices and detect handheld active electronics only within 2.5 m, though line of sight is unchanged.
Requires closer proximity than other ghosts to trigger a Music Box event and its cursed hunt.
A hunt that ignores voice or electronics just outside 2.5 m can identify it, with care taken to avoid Banshee confusion.

ghosts.name: Yurei
tells: Can close an open linked door fully and smoothly without a creak, creating EMF 2 and draining 15% sanity from players within 7.5 m.
Its door ability cannot merely nudge a door; a partial door movement outside hunts rules it out.
Incense confines it to the favourite room for 90 seconds and prevents its D.O.T.S. state during that period.
Can affect doors more forcefully than normal when opening them, but hunt door movement is standard.
Its ability can drain sanity from dead players, including before a possible revival.
